neighbours.label: Where a researcher is credited in psychology research writing: the slot before or the first name of the psychologist or study author (psychologist ___, conducted by ___)
fire: The famous obedience experiments conducted by Stanley Milgram showed how far people would go when instructed by an authority figure.
Psychologist Elizabeth Loftus demonstrated that eyewitness memories can be altered by misleading questions.
In a classic study by Leon Festinger, participants paid one dollar rated a boring task as more enjoyable than those paid twenty.
The marshmallow test, designed by psychologist Walter Mischel, measured children's ability to delay gratification.
According to developmental psychologist Jean Piaget, children pass through four distinct cognitive stages.
A 1951 conformity study conducted by Solomon Asch found that many participants agreed with an obviously wrong majority.
The attachment research of psychologist Mary Ainsworth introduced the Strange Situation procedure.
Social psychologist Philip Zimbardo ran the prison simulation in the basement of a university building.
quiet: The famous obedience experiments showed how far people would go when instructed by an authority figure.
Eyewitness memories can be altered by misleading questions, as several experiments have demonstrated.
In a classic study, participants paid one dollar rated a boring task as more enjoyable than those paid twenty.
The marshmallow test measured children's ability to delay gratification in a simple laboratory setting.
Many textbooks describe childhood as passing through four distinct cognitive stages.
A 1951 conformity study found that many participants agreed with an obviously wrong majority.
Attachment research introduced a laboratory procedure for observing infants separated from caregivers.
The prison simulation was held in the basement of a university building over several days.

predictions: Expect 6-7/8 fire above the bar. Near misses are the same sentences with the researcher's name removed, so they should stay near 0.1; the risk is that some near misses carry mild psychology-prose background.
